comment: Good professor, tests are very important.
Day to day this class was super easy - no hw and no attendance policy. Be ready to prepare for the exams, though. Don't wait until the last minute to do the group project.

Thompson is great at what he does. I learned a ton and even found myself enjoying using Excel. The main problem I had with his style of teaching is that he doesn't care to get to know his students at all. He's there to teach. Makes it harder to approach him for help than for most profs since you don't know him.

This is a very easy class in the day-to-day, there's no homework and attendance is optional. However, be ready to study up for exams and don't wait until the last minute to do the group project. Much easier than other professors for IT Data.

If every college professor was like this, education would be in a better state. He is clear and understanding throughout the class and offers to help if any situation. His class is a great environment for learning! Super chill and on the shortlist of professors who care. I would absolutely take it again.
He's the best professor ever!!! He's so patient and he always makes sure evey student catches up. And he's super fun.

Take this professor!  He very funny, you learn a lot, and the group projects are not difficult (if you put in the work).  Come to class because he sometimes takes attendance for your participation grade.  The exams are easy if you study.

Great class and he is a very nice guy.  The multiple group projects were a great opportunity to learn the applications.  For each project he let us evaluate our group members...any useless free-riders failed!

SThomps3 is the man. At first I thought he was gay, but apparently he's a manly man who likes a fine wine but doesn't know much about sports. We played with legos in class. That's how cool he is. Except he didn't really help us much on the final project, but he did help everyone else, so you have good odds.
Best professor hands down. Definitely take him if you can!!  He's one of the most helpful professors in Bschool, and if you don't do well, it's no one's fault but your own.

Very nice, soft spoken guy.  Most work can be turned in multiple times.  You learn a lot about Access and technology in general.  This isn't a class where students go in knowing the material.  Take him if you can.
The best professor at UR. Take his class!

Great guy, B-School could use more profs like Steve.  Very interesting course with a lot of valuable information to take out into the business world.  If you pay attention and study the notes, should be able to get an A.
Cares about students and always willing to help.  Sometimes talks over your head, assumes we know a lot about business and IT in general.  Exams are long, but not hard if you prepare.

He is a new teacher and a very nice guy... His tests are extrememly easy and he is very helpful...  I would give him a semester or two to figure out how to each this class though, it is kinda a mess right now.
